title: The Canopy Listening-Place Where Roots Learn to Sing Together

features.name: root-casing
features.desc-on-touch: The tree itself, antenna rising from the deep soil. You touch it and feel the bass notes from below traveling upward, the earth humming a name you almost recognize.

features.name: sound-gathering
features.desc-on-touch: Water pools here and vibrates with the song rising from root to root. Every frequency finds its reflection, and the reflection learns to sing back.

features.name: root-script
features.desc-on-touch: Marks in the stone where the singing was written by soil and time. You cannot read the words, but your body understands the melody.

features.name: canopy strata
features.desc-on-touch: Layers ascending into leaf and light. Each layer sings a different octave, and down here you hear them all at once, braided into one continuous voice.

features.name: creature-listener
features.desc-on-touch: A small bird, drawn by the singing from above and below. It sits between worlds, translating the song of roots into the song of leaves.

inscription: high in the leaves, the oldest roots still touch through the dark and name each other
